# WyvStudio

> WyvStudio (pronounced "weave studio") makes short ad and social videos for small brands and lean marketing teams, with no shoot: UGC-style ads with an AI presenter, your own face or no face at all, and product videos without a presenter. Its Creative Director plans each video from a product link, product photos or a sentence, shows the plan and the exact price first, and checks every video before you see it.

## What it makes

- UGC-style ads: testimonial, problem and solution, unboxing, before and after, comparison, POV hook, ASMR, day in the life, listicle, two-person skit, founder story, green screen over your own page, silent reaction.
- Product and brand videos without a presenter: motion design, kinetic type, product shots, explainers, data stories, and videos in the style of a reference ad you upload or link.
- 60+ ready AI presenters, your own face from one photo, and your own cloned voice. Brand names are pronounced the way you specify.
- Vertical 9:16, square and landscape exports, with scheduling to YouTube and TikTok.
- Works inside ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients through the WyvStudio connector (https://app.wyvstudio.com/mcp).

## Pricing (checked 22 November 2026)

- First ad free, made from a template, with a small watermark.
- $9 Test Pass, one time: 600 credits, enough for one UGC ad with a presenter or two 20-second videos.
- One-time packs, no subscription: Starter $47 (2,500 credits), Creator $157 (9,000 credits), Agency $299 (20,000 credits, 50 client workspaces).
- Top-ups from $8 for 500 credits. Monthly plans are also available in the app: $29, $59, $99 and $199.
- A typical 20-second video uses about 230 credits. 14-day money-back guarantee on every pack.

## Not a fit yet

- Live-action scenes with several people acting together, detailed body movement such as dance or sport, and faces or brands you don't have the rights to.
